# LG Home Comfort

> Ontario-based HVAC and home comfort solutions provider specializing in furnaces, air conditioning, heat pumps, and water systems with 24/7 emergency service.

LG Home Comfort serves residential and commercial customers across Ontario with comprehensive heating, cooling, and water treatment services. The company is backed by George Springer's charitable giveback program and operates with certified technicians offering installation, repair, and maintenance solutions.
